40014996.author: पदार्थः
40014996.content: सबले along with army, दशरथात्मजे Dasaratha's son, रामे Rama, सागरम् ocean, तीर्णे crossing the shore, श्रीमान् exuberant, रावणः Ravana, अमात्यौ with ministers, शुकसारणौ to Suka and Saarana, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40014996.author: Translation
40014996.content: On hearing about Rama, the son of Dasaratha crossing the shore of the ocean along with the army, exuberant Ravana spoke to his ministers Suka and Saarana.

40014997.author: पदार्थः
40014997.content: समग्रं all of them together, वानरम् Vanaras, बलम् army, दुस्तरम् arduous, सागरम् ocean, तीर्णम् crossed, रामेण by Rama, सागरे in the ocean अभूतपूर्वम् that which is not known before, सेतुबन्धनम् construction.

40014997.author: Translation
40014997.content: "That all the Vanara army together with Rama have crossed the arduous ocean and that the construction of a bridge (is possible) in the sea is not known before."

40014998.author: पदार्थः
40014998.content: सागरे in the sea, तम् they, सेतुबन्धम् constructed bridge, कथञ्चन even, नश्रद्दधाम् not believable, तत् those, वानरंबलम् Vanara force, मया to me, अवश्यम् surely, सङ् ख्येयंच the size of their army.

40014998.author: Translation
40014998.content: "It is not believable even to me that they constructed a bridge in the sea. Surely I wish to know the size of their army."

40014999.author: पदार्थः
40014999.content: भवन्तौ you both, अनुपलक्षितौ without their notice, वानरम् Vanara's, सैन्यम् army, प्रविश्य entering, परिमाणंच size of it, वीर्यंच heroes, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः of the monkeys, मुख्याः chief, रामस्य Rama's, सुग्रीवस्यच and Sugriva's, ये of those, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सङ्गताः groups, ये of those, पूर्वम् earlier, अभिवर्तन्ते those who are in forefront, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, शूराः warriors, सलिलार्णने in the abode of waters, सागरे in the sea, सः that, सेतुः bridge, यधा centre, बद्धः built, महात्मनाम् great, तेषां of those वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, निवेशम् location, यथा in the same way, रामस्यव्यवसायंच Rama's efforts, वीर्यम् valour, प्रहरणानिच weapons also, वीरस्य of the heroes, लक्षयणस्यच and of Lakshmana's, तत्त्वतः truly, ज्ञातुम् wish to know, अर्हथः I ought.

40014999.author: Translation
40014999.content: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."

40015000.author: पदार्थः
40015000.content: भवन्तौ you both, अनुपलक्षितौ without their notice, वानरम् Vanara's, सैन्यम् army, प्रविश्य entering, परिमाणंच size of it, वीर्यंच heroes, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः of the monkeys, मुख्याः chief, रामस्य Rama's, सुग्रीवस्यच and Sugriva's, ये of those, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सङ्गताः groups, ये of those, पूर्वम् earlier, अभिवर्तन्ते those who are in forefront, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, शूराः warriors, सलिलार्णने in the abode of waters, सागरे in the sea, सः that, सेतुः bridge, यधा centre, बद्धः built, महात्मनाम् great, तेषां of those वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, निवेशम् location, यथा in the same way, रामस्यव्यवसायंच Rama's efforts, वीर्यम् valour, प्रहरणानिच weapons also, वीरस्य of the heroes, लक्षयणस्यच and of Lakshmana's, तत्त्वतः truly, ज्ञातुम् wish to know, अर्हथः I ought.

40015001.author: पदार्थः
40015001.content: भवन्तौ you both, अनुपलक्षितौ without their notice, वानरम् Vanara's, सैन्यम् army, प्रविश्य entering, परिमाणंच size of it, वीर्यंच heroes, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः of the monkeys, मुख्याः chief, रामस्य Rama's, सुग्रीवस्यच and Sugriva's, ये of those, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सङ्गताः groups, ये of those, पूर्वम् earlier, अभिवर्तन्ते those who are in forefront, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, शूराः warriors, सलिलार्णने in the abode of waters, सागरे in the sea, सः that, सेतुः bridge, यधा centre, बद्धः built, महात्मनाम् great, तेषां of those वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, निवेशम् location, यथा in the same way, रामस्यव्यवसायंच Rama's efforts, वीर्यम् valour, प्रहरणानिच weapons also, वीरस्य of the heroes, लक्षयणस्यच and of Lakshmana's, तत्त्वतः truly, ज्ञातुम् wish to know, अर्हथः I ought.

40015001.content: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."

40015002.author: पदार्थः
40015002.content: भवन्तौ you both, अनुपलक्षितौ without their notice, वानरम् Vanara's, सैन्यम् army, प्रविश्य entering, परिमाणंच size of it, वीर्यंच heroes, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः of the monkeys, मुख्याः chief, रामस्य Rama's, सुग्रीवस्यच and Sugriva's, ये of those, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सङ्गताः groups, ये of those, पूर्वम् earlier, अभिवर्तन्ते those who are in forefront, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, शूराः warriors, सलिलार्णने in the abode of waters, सागरे in the sea, सः that, सेतुः bridge, यधा centre, बद्धः built, महात्मनाम् great, तेषां of those वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, निवेशम् location, यथा in the same way, रामस्यव्यवसायंच Rama's efforts, वीर्यम् valour, प्रहरणानिच weapons also, वीरस्य of the heroes, लक्षयणस्यच and of Lakshmana's, तत्त्वतः truly, ज्ञातुम् wish to know, अर्हथः I ought.

40015002.author: Translation
40015002.content: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."

40015003.author: पदार्थः
40015003.content: महौजसाम् highly energetic ones, तेषाम् those, वानराणाम् among the Vanaras, सेनापतिः army chief, कः who, तच्च all these, यथातत्त्वम् their matters, ज्ञात्वाशीघ्रम् knowing quickly, अगन्तुम् you return, अर्हथः fit.

40015003.author: Translation
40015003.content: Among those energetic Vanaras, who is the chief of the army? Knowing all these matters, it is fit for you to return quickly.

40015004.author: पदार्थः
40015004.content: इति thus, प्रतिसमाधिष्टौ having accepted the order, वीरौ heroes, शुकसारणौ S uka and Saarana, राक्षसौ both Rakshasas, हरिरूपधरौ taking the form of Vanaras, वानरम् in to Vanaras, बलम् army, प्रविष्टौ entered.

40015004.author: Translation
40015004.content: Having accepted the order, both the Rakshasa heroes, Suka and Saarana took the form of Vanaras and entered the Vanara army.

40015005.author: पदार्थः
40015005.content: ततः there upon, तौ both of them, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, आचिन्त्यम् that which cannot be conceived, रोमहर्षणम् that which caused raising of hair (stunned), तत् that, वानरम् Vanara's, सैन्यम् army, सङ् ख्यातुम् to count the numbers, तदा that time, नाध्यगच्छेताम् whose number could not be known (not conceived).

40015005.author: Translation
40015005.content: There upon both Suka and Saarana did not know the numbers (of the army) at that time as they could not count the numbers from there as it could not be conceived. It caused the raising of their hair.

40015006.author: पदार्थः
40015006.content: पर्वताग्रेषु on mountain summits, निर्दरेषु in caverns, गुहासुच in caves, समुद्रस्य ocean's, तीरेषु shores, वनेषु in forests, उपवनेषुच and adjoining gardens, स्थितम् settled, तरमाणम् crossing, तीर्णंच shores, तर्तुकामंच some in the process of crossing, सर्वशः all over, निविष्टम् settled, निविश्चे staying, भीमनादम् terrific noise, महाबलम् great force, अक्षोभ्यम् that which is never ending, तद्बलार्णवम् that ocean of army, निशाचरौ the Rakshasas, ददृशाते witnessed.

40015006.author: Translation
40015006.content: The ocean of army settled on the mountain summits, in caverns and caves, on the shores of the ocean, in the forests and adjoining gardens some who crossed the sea some in the process of crossing settled all over was witnessed by the Rakshasas. It was never ending and making terrific noise.

40015007.author: पदार्थः
40015007.content: पर्वताग्रेषु on mountain summits, निर्दरेषु in caverns, गुहासुच in caves, समुद्रस्य ocean's, तीरेषु shores, वनेषु in forests, उपवनेषुच and adjoining gardens, स्थितम् settled, तरमाणम् crossing, तीर्णंच shores, तर्तुकामंच some in the process of crossing, सर्वशः all over, निविष्टम् settled, निविश्चे staying, भीमनादम् terrific noise, महाबलम् great force, अक्षोभ्यम् that which is never ending, तद्बलार्णवम् that ocean of army, निशाचरौ the Rakshasas, ददृशाते witnessed.

40015007.author: Translation
40015007.content: The ocean of army settled on the mountain summits, in caverns and caves, on the shores of the ocean, in the forests and adjoining gardens some who crossed the sea some in the process of crossing settled all over was witnessed by the Rakshasas. It was never ending and making terrific noise.

40015008.author: पदार्थः
40015008.content: महातेजाः brilliant one, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रतिच्छन्नौ hidden, तौ those two, ददर्श saw, सः that, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, गृहीत्वा took hold of, रामाय Rama's, आचचक्षे brought to the notice.

40015008.author: Translation
40015008.content: Brilliant Vibheeshana saw both Suka and Saarana hidden in the army. He took hold of them and brought to the notice of Rama.

40015009.author: पदार्थः
40015009.content: परपुरञ्जय conqueror of enemy 's citadels, तस्य its, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, मन्त्रिणौ ministers, एतौ those two, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, चारौ spies, लङ्कायाः from Lanka, समनुप्राप्तौ have come to find out.

40015009.author: Translation
40015009.content: "O conqueror of enemy's citadels! these are spies from Lanka, Suka and Saarana who have come to find us out."

40015010.author: पदार्थः
40015010.content: तौ those two, रामम् at Rama, दृष्टवा to look, व्यथितौ worried, तथा so also, जीविते of life, निराशौ lost hope, भीतौ caught up with fear, कृताञ्जलिपुटौ lifted up their palms greeting, इदम् these, वचनम् words, ऊचतुः expressed.

40015010.author: Translation
40015010.content: The two (Rakshasa spies) got worried to look at Rama and also lost hope of their life. Caught up with fear they lifted their palms greeting Rama and expressed these words.

40015011.author: पदार्थः
40015011.content: सौम्य noble, राघवनन्दन delight of Raghu race, आवाम् come, रावणस्रहितौ assigned by Ravana, तव to you, इदम् thus, सर्वम् entire, बलम् army strength, परिज्ञातुम् to know about, इह here, आगतौ arrived.

40015011.author: Translation
40015011.content: "O noble one! We have come to you assigned by Ravana. O delight of Raghu race, thus we arrived here to know about the entire strength of your army."

40015012.author: पदार्थः
40015012.content: दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, सर्वभूतहिते the wellbeing of all beings, रतः remains devoted, रामः Rama, तयोः to both of them, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रूत्वा on hearing, प्रहसन् smiling, वाक्यम् words, आब्रवीत् spoke.

40015012.author: Translation
40015012.content: "On hearing (the spies) Dasaratha's son Rama who remains devoted to the wellbeing of all beings spoke these words smiling at both of them."

40015013.author: पदार्थः
40015013.content: सर्वम् entire, बलम् army, दृष्टंयदि looking at the, वयम् our, सुपरिक्षिताःवा observing well, यथोक्तम् that which is appropriate, कार्यम् action, कृतंना accomplishing, छन्दतः freely, प्रतिगम्यताम् you may return back.

40015013.author: Translation
40015013.content: After observing our entire army carefully, acting appropriately (according to Ravana's words) and accomplishing your task you may freely return (said Rama to the spies).

40015014.author: पदार्थः
40015014.content: अथा and now, किञ्चित् even a bit, अदृष्टंवा not seen, तत् that, भूयः you may do, द्रष्टुम् see, अर्हथः ought to see, ना or else, विभीषणः Vibheeshana कात्स्नर्येन in totality, भूयः you may, सन्दर्शयिष्यति will show you.

40015014.author: Translation
40015014.content: "If you have not seen even a bit, you ought to see. Or else Vibheeshana will show you the total army."

40015015.author: पदार्थः
40015015.content: इदम् thus, ग्रहम् having been caught, प्राप्य by us, जीवितंप्रति in turn of your life, न not, वा or, भेतव्यम् apprehension, न्यस्तशस्त्रौ those who do not possess, गृहीतौ wield, दूतौ envoys, वदम् to slay अर्हतः ought to.

40015015.author: Translation
40015015.content: As you have been caught by us like this you need not have apprehension of your life. Those who do not possess wield or those who are envoys ought not to be slayed.

40015016.author: पदार्थः
40015016.content: विभीषण Vibheeshana, सततं ever, शत्रुपक्षस्य enemy's side, विकर्षिणौ seeking to divide, प्रच्छमानौ are requesting, चारौ spies, उभौ both, रात्रिंचरौ night rangers, विमुञ्च free.

40015016.author: Translation
40015016.content: "Vibheeshana! Even though they are spies seeking to divide the enemy army as both the night rangers have been requesting, you may set them free."

40015017.author: पदार्थः
40015017.content: लङ्कांनगरीम् into the city of Lanka, प्रविश्य on entering, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, राजा king, धनदानुजः younger brother of Kubera, भवद् भ्याम् to them, ममवचनम् my words, यथोक्तम् as it is told by me, वक्तव्यः you may tell.

40015017.author: Translation
40015017.content: "Upon entering the city of Lanka, you may tell my words to the king of Rakshasas, the younger brother of Kubera just as it was told by me."

40015018.author: पदार्थः
40015018.content: यत् that which, बलम् strength, समाश्रित्य relying on which, मे my, सीताम् Sita, हृतावान् has been abducted अपिच and also, तत् that, ससैन्यः along with army, सहभान्दव and relations, यथाकाम् at his will, दर्शय you may display.

40015018.author: Translation
40015018.content: "Let him display the strength on which he has abducted my Sita along with his army and relations at his will."

40015019.author: पदार्थः
40015019.content: श्वः tomorrow, काल्ये at day dawn, मया of me, शरैः arrows, विध्वंसितम् will crush, रक्षसम् Rakshasas, बलम् strength, सप्राकाराम् in the same manner, सतोरणाम् the arches of the entrance, लङ्कांनगरीम् of Lanka city, पश्य you may see.

40015019.author: Translation
40015019.content: At dawn tomorrow, you may see how I will crush the arches of the entrance of Lanka city and the strength of Rakshasas."

40015020.author: पदार्थः
40015020.content: रावण Ravana, श्वः tomorrow, काल्ये at day dawn, वज्रवान् wielder of thunderbolt, वासवः Vasava, दानवेषु at Rakshasas, वज्रम् इव like the thunder bolt, ससैन्ये even the army also, त्वयि you. भीमम् dreadful, क्रोधम् anger, अहम् of mine, मोक्ष्यामि will release.

40015020.author: Translation
40015020.content: "Tomorrow at the dawn of the day I will release my dreadful anger on Ravana and even on Rakshasas just as the thunderbolt of Indra was released on Rakshasas."

40015021.author: पदार्थः
40015021.content: इति thus, प्रतिसमाधिष्टौ heard the words of reply, राक्षसौ both the Rakshasas, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, धर्मवत्सलम् lover of dharma, एनम् in that manner, राघवम् Raghava, जयइतिप्रतिनन्द्य praising saying ' victory to you', लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka, आगम्य having reached, राक्षसाधिपम् king of Rakshasas, अब्रूताम् said like this.

40015021.author: Translation
40015021.content: Having heard the reply of Rama, both the Rakshasas Suka and Saarana praising Rama saying, "Victory to you!" reached Lanka and said to the king of Rakshasas as follows.

40015022.author: पदार्थः
40015022.content: इति thus, प्रतिसमाधिष्टौ heard the words of reply, राक्षसौ both the Rakshasas, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, धर्मवत्सलम् lover of dharma, एनम् in that manner, राघवम् Raghava, जयइतिप्रतिनन्द्य praising saying ' victory to you', लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka, आगम्य having reached, राक्षसाधिपम् king of Rakshasas, अब्रूताम् said like this.

40015022.author: Translation
40015022.content: Having heard the reply of Rama, both the Rakshasas Suka and Saarana praising Rama saying, "Victory to you!" reached Lanka and said to the king of Rakshasas as follows.

40015023.author: पदार्थः
40015023.content: क्षसेश्वर Lord of Rakshasas, वधार्थम् for the sake of slaying, विभीषणगृहीतौ held captive by Vibheeshana, धर्मात्मना righteous self, अमिततेजसा highly effulgent, रामेण by Rama, दृष्टवा seeing, मुक्तौ released.

40015023.author: Translation
40015023.content: "O king of Rakshasas! Vibheeshana held us captive for slaying us. But righteous self, Rama, the highly effulgent one released us on seeing."

40015024.author: पदार्थः
40015024.content: लोकपालसमाः equal to rulers of the world, शूराः heroic ones, कृतास्त्राः wielders of weapons, दृढविक्रमाः of remarkable bra very, दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, श्रीमान् exuberant, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, महातेजाः highly brilliant one, महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः resembles Indra in valour, सुग्रीवश्च and Sugriva's, चत्वारः all the four, पुरुषर्षभाः bulls among men, यत्र there, एकस्थानगताः come together, एते these, सप्राकाराम् that manner, सतोरणाम् the archways, लङ्कांपुरीम् of Lanka, उत्पाट्य unearth, सङ्क्रमयितुम् , शक्ताः capable, सर्वे even if all, वानराः Vanaras, तिष्ठन्तु keep away.

40015024.author: Translation
40015024.content: "Exuberant Rama and Lakshmana, highly brilliant Vibheeshana, and Sugriva who resembles Indra in his valour, are like rulers of the world and are heroic, wielders of weapons and bulls among men. If all four of them come together there in that manner, they will unearth the arch ways and even the city of Lanka. They are capable even if the Vanaras are kept away."

40015027.author: पदार्थः
40015027.content: रामस्य Rama's, तत् that, रूपम् form, यादृशम् to see, प्रहरणानिचएकः weapons, he alone, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, वधिष्यति will slay, तेत्रयः those three, तिष्ठन्तु even keep away.

40015027.author: Translation
40015027.content: "If we see Rama's form and his weapon it is enough. He can alone slay even when all the other three keep away."

40015028.author: पदार्थः
40015028.content: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता even if Rama and Lakshmana are protected, सुग्रीवेणच and Sugriva also, सावाहिनी that ocean of army, सर्वैः entire, सुरासुरैःअपि even suras and asuras, दुर्दर्षतर formidable, बभूव seems.

40015028.author: Translation
40015028.content: "Even if Rama and Lakshmana are protected, and even Sugriva also, the entire army seems formidable like suras and asuras."
